notes.title: Big Balance Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Taunted characters now always fire their skill against the source of the taunt, even in skill cases that filter to specific units, such as Crosby’s “farthest target”. A taunted Crosby will now fire the skill at the taunt source.

Turbo nerfed - Starting mana reduced to 20 (was 50). Max Mana increased to 110 (was 90). Damage reduced to 60 per retaliatory hit (was 75).

The Forever Scythe nerfed - Now grants 10% more Lifesteal after 8 seconds (was 20%).

Soulburn Greaves nerfed - attacks now deal 1% HP damage to Ignited foes (was 2%).

Charlie nerfed - now has 40 Max Mana (was 35).

Fixed a bug where Bug was granting 30% Damage Reduction (now correctly grants the intended 20% Damage Reduction).

Defiler buffed - now executes at 20% max HP or below (was 15%).

Engineer buffed - Turret now starts at 40 damage (was 30), and gains +4 damage per Tier above 1 (was +3).

Ignite nerfed - healing reduction reduced to 50% (was 75%).

Porcino buffed - Skill damage increased to 175 (was 160). Starting Mana increased to 10 (was 0). Porcino also now gains +1 Attack Range for the rest of combat with each cast.

Fritz buffed - Skill damage increased to 180 (was 150). Shred duration increased to 6 seconds (from 5).

Tidus buffed - Main wave damage increased to 300 (was 200). Sub-wave damage increased to 120 (was 100).

Champigno buffed - Mush-Turrets now completely copy Champigno’s attack speed (previously copied 75% of Attack Speed)

Burdanna buffed - each time it pulses, the owner also heals 5% Max HP.

Deadhead nerfed - max Mana increased to 80 (from 60).

Shred nerfed - now increases damage by 20% (was 30%).

Gorbin nerfed - now Shreds for 3 seconds (was 5).

Prince Harming has a new passive: he now takes 25% less Spell damage.

Khepri changed: Starting mana reduced to 0 (was 45). Shield increased to 350 (was 300).

Fixed a bug that was causing Button to not reduce foes’ Max HP as much as the damage dealt from the Spores.

Button has gained a new passive: At the start of combat, Button gains 300 (scaling with Spell Power) empty Max HP.

Fixed a bug where Barq’s attacks took notably longer than other melee characters.

Baalor changed - Starting and Max Mana changed to 100/135 (was 125/150).

Ian buffed - Skill now takes 1 second to cast (from 2).

Monty slightly buffed - Spectral Snakes (from cast) now deal 240% of Monty’s Attack Damage (from 225%).

Elder Reto buffed - Meteor damage now 450 (was 300).

Harmony skill nerfed - now grants 8 base Spell Power and Attack Speed (from 10).

Magicannon buffed - now Stuns the Shocked target for 1 second when the effect activates in addition to the damage, and counts up on the wielder rather than the target (meaning it is easier to activate if the target switches or dies).

Vex tweaked. If Vex casts on a Stifle or Stun immune target, the rest of the skill’s effects still completely apply.

Glitter tweaked. If Glitter casts on a Crowd Control immune target, the skill instead immediately deals its damage. (Also, added some nice new visual effects for Glitter’s skill!) Glitter also now prioritizes the highest Attack Damage foe to ensheepify.

Renamed the Orb of Greatness to the Ruby Sphere to prevent confusion with two of the buildable items having the same first word in their name.

Changed the way Geogukk’s Tier is derived from your Dwellers’ Tiers - it’s now based on the total Tier (rather than average Tier), meaning adding a Tier 1 unit will improve your progress, rather than potentially reducing the average Tier among your Dwellers!

Fixed a bug that was causing the Cull blessing to not banish any Units.

Fixed a bug that caused Volcanus to become unable to cast if he was Crowd Control immune or Disarm immune.

Sir Sparkles buffed: now grants 10 Armor to himself and the unit being casted on.

Fixed an exploit that let you sell the Boss Marker on the table for Star Points.

Stormy Skies skill buffed - now deals 250 damage per thunderbolt thrown (was 150).

Jumpers trait changed - now This Means Warp, a powerful new perk which causes your units to Teleport instead of moving!

Arbiter (PVP Combat Modifier) nerfed - now grants 20% Attack Damage (was 30%) and 7 Mana Regen (was 8).

The Wanderer (PVP Combat Modifier) nerfed - now ONLY starts with the Rare unit. Added some clarifying text to Wanderer bundles.

Cactus Nymph (PVP Combat Modifier) buffed - now deals 15 damage back per item (was 10).

notes.title: ICYMI: Tales & Tactics For The Fans Update!
notes.content:
Hey there! In case you happened to miss our previous announcements, we're back with one massive content update with something for everyone! We've got a whole bunch of features, content, and balance for both PvE and PvP modes, as well as a new sandbox mode specifically requested by the community.

[h3]⭐ Highlights of the update include:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Unlock / Component Item - The Scythe!
[*]New "Brutal" difficulty levels - ready for even more of a challenge?
[*]New Bonus Traits, new Perks, new Combatants!
[*]Test strategies in the highly-requested Sandbox Mode!
[*]Adapt to new metas in 2-week rotating PvP Seasons!
[*]Battle friends in custom PvP Lobbies!
[*]Tuning & polish across lots of traits, units, and items!
[*]Two new supported languages - Russian and Korean - provided by our community members Anti6eptik and Nyamnami. Thank you![/list]

…and much more!  Read the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1652250/view/503951081162670472]here[/url] or watch the new and shiny update trailer [url=https://youtu.be/quxOS-u9Nx0?feature=shared]here[/url]!

[previewyoutube=quxOS-u9Nx0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]❗[b]IMPORTANT:[/b]  Unreal Engine Upgrade[/h2]

We’ve updated the game’s engine version, which normally doesn’t require an announcement but this version does seem to trigger a first-time-launch shader compiling step for most users. This may cause a black screen for a minute or so when you first launch the game after updating, but will not happen again after that first delayed launch.


We hope you've been enjoying the new update! Do let us know your thoughts on it and don't forget to drop a review!

notes.title: For The Fans + Camp Yog Sale!
notes.content:
We're back, with one massive content update with something for everyone! We've got a whole bunch of features, content, and balance for both PvE and PvP modes, as well as a new sandbox mode specifically requested by the community.

[h3]⭐ Highlights of the update include:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New Unlock / Component Item - The Scythe!
[*]New "Brutal" difficulty levels - ready for even more of a challenge?
[*]New Bonus Traits, new Perks, new Combatants!
[*]Test strategies in the highly-requested Sandbox Mode!
[*]Adapt to new metas in 2-week rotating PvP Seasons!
[*]Battle friends in custom PvP Lobbies!
[*]Tuning & polish across lots of traits, units, and items!
[*]Two new supported languages - Russian and Korean - provided by our community members Anti6eptik and Nyamnami. Thank you![/list]

…and much more!  Read the full patch notes [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1652250/view/503951081162670472]here[/url] or watch the new and shiny update trailer [url=https://youtu.be/quxOS-u9Nx0?feature=shared]here[/url]!

[previewyoutube=quxOS-u9Nx0;full][/previewyoutube]

This update has been in development for some time, and in that time, one feature we did talk about throughout the year in 2024 has turned out to be too costly to continue. We made the hard call to no longer pursue controller support for this project, and instead focused our efforts on all the rest of the core gameplay features and content that make up this update. Controller support wasn't originally planned from the project’s start, and that put a large sunk cost into adding it later. Too large, at least for the moment. We may revisit in the future, but for now, we're putting controller support officially on the backburner. Sorry for any players who were looking forward to this feature - we hope there's enough meat on For The Fans to make up for it!

[h2]❗[b]IMPORTANT:[/b]  Unreal Engine Upgrade[/h2]

We’ve updated the game’s engine version, which normally doesn’t require an announcement but this version does seem to trigger a first-time-launch shader compiling step for most users. This may cause a black screen for a minute or so when you first launch the game after updating, but will not happen again after that first delayed launch.

[h2]🏕️ Camp Yog Sale[/h2]

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CampYogSale]Camp Yog Sale[/url] is now LIVE! Tales & Tactics will be a part of this sale with a huge [b]66% OFF.[/b] Whether you’ve been waiting to pick the game up yourself or buy it for a friend, this is a great time to do so! You can also check out the rest of the Yogscast Games roster and see if anything piques your interest.

[h3]What's included:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Amazing discounts on our published games
[*]Sneak peeks at upcoming releases
[*]Free demos to try
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the new update, we've definitely enjoyed working on it! Do let us know your thoughts on it.

notes.title: For The Fans Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Shared Mode Features[/b][/h1]

[h3]New Component - [b]The Scythe[/b][/h3]
A new Unlock has been added, which adds a brand new Component item! The Scythe increases Lifesteal at its base, and as a component item, it merges with every other component into a brand new item. These items are:
[list]
[*][b](+Gloves) Leeching Grasp[/b]: On Hit: Heal 25 HP. This is a reskin and switch of recipes for the Blessed Blade, which still has Lifesteal but now adds an additional Attack Speed scaling Healing aspect.

[*][b](+Sword) Whispering Blade[/b]: Whenever the wearer deals ANY damage, they gain 0.5% Attack Damage, up to a cap.

[*][b](+Shield) Helm of Hatred[/b]: Start of combat: Lose 50% max HP, then become invulnerable for 7 seconds.

[*][b](+Crystal) Brainleech Pendant[/b]: Start of combat; Psy-Link to the furthest foe. Steal 20 Mana and 2 Mana Regen from them.

[*][b](+Staff) Reaper's Tome[/b]: Whenever the wearer heals allies for a total of 300 HP, they gain 10 Spell Power (up to 100).

[*][b](+Meat) Vengeful Armament[/b]: Store 20% of Health lost. Whenever the wearer casts, deal the stored damage to adjacent enemies as Spell damage.

[*][b](+Ring) The Forever Scythe[/b]: After:
[list]
[*][i]8 seconds[/i]: Gain 20% more Lifesteal.
[*][i]16 seconds[/i]: And a 50% max HP Shield.
[*][i]32 seconds[/i]: And 30% Damage Amp and Damage Resist.
[/list]
[*][b](+Scythe) Infuser[/b]: Healing from Lifesteal does not heal the wearer. Instead, it charges up the Infuser. Every 3 seconds, all stored healing is sent to the most damaged allied unit.
[/list]
A new “[b]Mastery[/b]” perk has been added as well for the Scythe component: Your units with an equipped Scythe component or Scythe completed item become invulnerable for 2 seconds at 10% HP.

[b]Dueling Sai[/b] (formerly Gloves + Shield) is now built by combining Sword and Shield.

Gloves + Shield now combines into a new item, the [b]Soulburn Greaves[/b]: Whenever an enemy attacks the wearer, Ignite it for 2 seconds. Whenever the wearer attacks, Ignited enemies lose 2% HP.

[h1][b]PvE Features[/b][/h1]

[h3]New Difficulty Tiers - [b]Brutal 1-5[/b][/h3]
Ready for a new challenge? The next 5 stages of Challenge Climb have been added, dubbed “[b]Brutal 1-5[/b]”. These tiers are named differently because, unlike other Challenge Climb stages which tend to add new mechanics in addition to challenge, Brutal is strictly about the challenge. Each stage will increase raw enemy Damage Resistance and Damage Amp, in addition to other gameplay modifiers.

The character select badges will reflect the new Challenge Climb stages, showing up to 20 now.

[h3]New Bonus Traits & More Bonus Trait Units[/h3]

Two new Bonus Traits have been added as late path Unlocks! In addition, every existing Bonus Trait has a new Unit added to it, making these builds more versatile than standard Traits. With this change,[b] every standard pool Unit now has a Bonus trait[/b]! The new Traits are:
[list]
[*][b]Pack[/b] - The Pack trait is the most straightforward we’ve ever made, and quite possibly the most powerful - it simply adds +1 Max Army Size so long as you meet the stage requirements. Enjoy bigger armies than we’ve ever allowed before!

[*][b]Corrupted[/b] - The Corrupted trait involves the Curse mechanic, granting extra Corrupted Units at the end of each combat, but at the cost of raising your Curse. Use it as an early splash for an economy trait, or take to its 2nd stage at the late game, where all of your Tier 4 Units gain significant power.
[/list]
The [b]Blood[/b] trait also now can earn a 2nd stage effect at 5 Units: Enemy Units lose 1% HP for each Star Point the sacrificed Unit is worth.

The Units who have gained new Bonus Traits are:
[list]
[*][b]Zwei[/b] - now [i]Divine[/i].
[*][b]Gibbs[/b] - now [i]Arcane[/i]. Gibbs’ Enlightened modifier shares his entire skill effect to all adjacent allies!
[*][b]Morita[/b] - now [i]Trickster[/i].
[*][b]Button, Mikki, Willow[/b] - now [i]Blood[/i].
[*][b]Fester[/b] - now [i]Aquatic[/i].
[*][b]Gale[/b] - now [i]Royal[/i].
[*][b]Gorzak[/b] - now [i]Spirit[/i].
[*][b]Jabbar[/b] - now [i]Storm[/i].
[*][b]Ian[/b] - now [i]Flame[/i].
[/list]
New Perks have been added to support these new Bonus Traits:
[list]
[*][b]Dark Depths[/b] - You no longer gain Units from the Corrupted Trait. Instead, Corrupted units gain +3% Damage Amp and Damage Resistance per Curse.

[*][b]Pack Master[/b] - Pack units gain +200 Base Max HP per unused Army Size.
[/list]
[h3]New PvE Perks[/h3]

Two new packs of PVE perks have been added to the Unlocks!
[list]
[*][b]Pack 1 - Meta[/b]
[list]
[*][i][b]Grace[/b][/i] - Instantly Tier Up your units to Tier 3.
[*][i][b]Cull[/b][/i] - Instantly Banish 12 random units.
[*][i][b]Loads of Candy[/b][/i] - Gain 20 Star Points. You don’t gain a free Reroll each combat.
[/list]
[*][b]Pack 2 - Power[/b]
[list]
[*][i][b]Jumpers[/b][/i] - Whenever one of your units moves, it gets +3 Attack Speed for the rest of combat.
[*][i][b]Exploit[/b][/i] - Whenever your units attack Crowd Controlled foes, they gain 3 Mana.
[*][i][b]Tombstone[/b][/i] - Whenever one of your units dies, it gives the lowest health ally a Shield for 20% of its max health and 20 Mana.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Sandbox Mode[/h3]

At the end of the Unlock tree now lies an entry for [b]Sandbox Mode[/b], a feature specifically requested by our community for theorycrafting aid. When starting a game in Sandbox mode, the game will never advance past the first floor, but you will be granted many reusable trinkets to gain resources, load specific Regions, and most importantly - many buttons will appear when viewing the Compendium that allow you spawn anything from there directly into the game. You can freely spawn Units, Items, and more from the Compendium at will.

You will also receive two special clipboard trinkets - the Sandbox Saver and the Sandbox Loader, which utilize the system clipboard. This means when you Save a sandbox layout, you can send it to someone else to Load, so you can share states with friends or community members as you discuss theories!

Sandbox Mode can be used in this way to repeat fights without any variance, which can be useful in identifying specific interactions, eyeing weaknesses and strengths, or just seeing if a fight was so close that it might have been decided by a coinflip (such as Crit or random chance effect going off at just the right time).

[h3]Revived & New PvE Combatants[/h3]
As part of Community Challenge #5, we asked for ideas for new effects on some PVE combatants we had turned off over the course of development. We’ve revived four former combatants inspired by these suggestions, as well as spun up a couple of our own! Some are a part of the standard pool, while four of these have been formed into a new unlock pack, mostly so they can be disabled for players who may not want to run into them. Thanks to community members Naelhinn, Anti6eptik, Sophia, JackRenoson, CsDavis, and D0omsday for their suggestions that shape these combatant effects.

These new Combatants are:
[list]
[*][b]Always Available[/b]
[list]
[*][i][b]Dust Devil[/b][/i] - All Units' Attack Range is halved this combat.
[*][i][b]Doomsayer[/b][/i] - 20 seconds into combat, a meteor impact Stuns ALL Units for 5 seconds and deals 250 Spell Damage.
[/list]
[*][b]Combatant Unlock Pack 3[/b]
[list]
[*][i][b]Shapeshifter[/b][/i] - At the start of combat, the lowest Tier Unit on each side permanently transforms into a Unit of the same rarity and Tiers Up.
[*][i][b]Morphologist[/b][/i] - At the start of combat, the lowest Tier Unit on each side permanently transforms into a Unit of one higher rarity.
[*][i][b]Wanderer[/b][/i] - At the start of combat, a random Tier 1 Rare Unit joins each side, permanently.
[*][i][b]Goblin Goofballs[/b][/i] - At the start of combat, each team's highest Tier Unit is sold for 4x its Star Point value.
[/list][/list]
[h3]Shadow Strike Rework[/h3]

We’ve gotten several discussion threads about the Shadow Strike hexes that helped to identify the friction points that made this particular Challenge Climb modifier more frustrating than most. While it was originally designed to challenge positioning, it did so in a way that ended up being tedious. Expecting to change positions every battle often meant just holding two different positions in your head and alternating them between fights, which was adding tedium without really adding much depth of gameplay. So, we’ve reworked them in this update.

Shadow Strike Hexes now randomize their locations at the start of each region and stay there. They no longer are based on where your units were placed. The number of hexes has increased to 3/6 (from 2/4). In addition each region has its own unique Shadow Strike effects:
[list]
[*][b]City[/b] - Current 50% HP loss.
[*][b]Tournament[/b] - Hobbled & Shredded for the entire combat.
[*][b]Desert[/b] - Frozen for 15 seconds.
[*][b]Factory[/b] - Loses 5% of HP every second for 20 seconds.
[*][b]Cavern[/b] - Stifled for the entire combat.
[*][b]Lab[/b] - Permanently transforms into a unit of the same rarity & tier.
[*][b]Graveyard[/b] - Grants 10% Damage Amp for the opposing team.[/list]

[h1][b]PvP Features[/b][/h1]

[h3]Unranked Removal[/h3]
Unranked was by far our least played mode, and was more often used by veteran players to test new builds without risk. We already don’t allow de-ranking to allow for moments of testing riskier builds, so in practice, these things together created an unfun experience for new players going into unranked thinking it would be easier and actually facing a much more challenging field of opponents than they expected. We made the call to remove it, and rename Ranked mode to “Classic PvP”.

[h3]Rotating Season Mode[/h3]

There is now a brand new way to play PvP - a [b]Season[/b] mode! Season will automatically rotate every 2 weeks, and will forcibly alter the meta by way of banning various elements. Each PvP Season contains:
[list]
[*]A random Region being chosen as the place to play this Season, [b]including activating its Region modifier[/b]!
[*]A random Trait ban
[*]A random Component item ban
[*]A random Perk group banned (such as Otto being banned)
[*]8 Combatants banned[/list]

Playing in a Season will only match you with armies from other players also playing in that Season. We’re very excited to see how players develop temporary metas to deal with the Season bans, and we may add more to the banlist depending on how much the current setup is shifting the strategies.

You will be able to view all of your Season history rank earnings in the Multiplayer section of the main menu at any time.

[h3]New PvP Combatants[/h3]

27 new PvP Combatants have been added to the pool, [b]doubling[/b] the total number available!
[list]
[*][b]Cool Cultist[/b] - You can see all Mythic units in the Unit Store. Start with a random Common Mythic instead of a Common Unit.

[*][b]Alli-gladiator[/b] - Your Skirmisher Archetype units gain 15 Attack Speed.

[*][b]Rogue Tinkerer[/b] - Start the run with a Portable Forge, which can remove and unmerge Equipment from your units.

[*][b]Wandering Wizard[/b] - Your Magician Archetype units gain 20 Spell Power.

[*][b]Lane Bully[/b] - When you win, increase your WinStreak. When you lose, gain rewards based on your WinStreak.

[*][b]Geomancer[/b] - Your Tank Archetype units gain 10 Armor.

[*][b]Slime Farmer[/b] - Your Vault becomes the Star Crown Vault this run. Start the run with the Vault already invested in.

[*][b]Guard Captain[/b] - Start with three Contracts for specific Units of increasing rarities. They earn SP & Gold when completed.

[*][b]Dastardly Desperado[/b] - Start with an extra random component item.

[*][b]Circus Performer[/b] - Your units gain 3 Attack Speed and Spell Power for each unique Trait you've completed a combat with.

[*][b]Gob Barker [/b]- Each fight, guess who wins! If you guess correctly, earn 2 Star Point if you won or 5 if your foe did.

[*][b]Arbiter[/b] - Your Units without active Traits gain +30% Attack Damage, +20 Armor and 8 Mana Regen.

[*][b]Grave Keeper[/b] - Start with the unique item 'Reaper' instead of a Component. It levels up every time 20 Units die. Grave Keeper’s other component will always be a Scythe.

[*][b]Doomsayer[/b] - When you have 1 Heart left, gain 10 Star Points, 8 Gold, and two random Components.

[*][b]Cactus Nymph[/b] - Your units deal 10 Spell Damage back when attacked for each equipped item.

[*][b]Dust Devil[/b] - Your Units move faster. When they move, they gain 25% damage reduction and 25 Attack Speed for 5 seconds.

[*][b]Golem Guardian [/b]- After combat, if you have no Units on the Bench, gain 4 Star Points.

[*][b]Gorgon[/b] - Your first Unit to be attacked 15 times gains Stoneskin, which grants +20 Armor and +25% Max HP.

[*][b]Disciple of Trollgar [/b]- Non-free rolls of the Unit Store will include one Tier 2 unit.

[*][b]Assistotron[/b] - Gain a random Tier 2 Uncommon at the start of the run, equipped with the Commitment Badge. The Commitment Badge occupies an item slot and cannot be removed, and also makes the Unit unable to be transformed, sold, or benched. It is a hard commitment to include that unit in your Army, in exchange for a powerful early game advantage.

[*][b]Gemclops[/b] - Whenever your units apply Crowd Control, they deal 25% Spell Power damage to the target.

[*][b]Priest of Adalon[/b] - Your Tier 3 and higher Units get +30% Maximum Health.

[*][b]Clean Machine[/b] - Your front two columns become healing Spring hexes.

[*][b]The Wanderer[/b] - Start with a random Rare replacing three Units.

[*][b]Goblin Goofballs[/b] - Goof off! Start the run at the first Perk selection with -2 Lives, 22 SP, 24 Gold, 5 Rerolls, and a random Banner.[/list]

[h3]PvP Combatant Updates[/h3]

In addition to all the new ones, a few existing Combatants have been updated:
[list]
[*][b]Unlucky Lass[/b] is reworked - Now starts with 2 Lucky Charms, and gets another Lucky Charm at each perk choice.
[i]The former Lass effect was too little a reward for the build-around, and we’ve introduced a new more effective “traitless” build around combatant.[/i]

[*][b]Eager Newbie[/b] now grants 6 Star Points instead of 4 SP + 2 Lucky Clovers.
[i]Overperforming slightly and overly similar to the reworked Unlucky Lass. Now makes the effect extra simple for new players as well, which was the Newbie’s original intent.[/i]

[*][b]Star Student[/b] has been reworked. When your Units cast, they gain 25 Spell Power and require 10% more mana to cast.
[i]Hasn’t been a very impactful choice you can build around. With no stacking limit on this new effect, breaking it can lead to some very unique builds.[/i]

[*][b]Death Wing Disciple’s[/b] Ritual hex now grants 40% of the sacrificed unit’s Max HP to allies (down from 75%).
[i]Overperforming.[/i]

[*][b]Bad Necromancer’s [/b]Zombie health increased: 33% -> 40% of Highest Health Unit’s HP.
[i]Slightly underperforming.[/i]

[*][b]Fallen Fanatic[/b]: Now also adds a 5% max hp (additive with items, not base HP) to all Units.
[i]This is a very small buff, but maybe enough to bring up Fanatic’s pick rate.[/i]

[*][b]Shapeshifter & Taskmaster[/b]: Now present their Banners during the character selection process, but it replaces a component.

[*][b]Sludge Captain[/b]: Now places the Mud tokens in your front two columns, but also makes your team immune to Hobbled and Shredded.
[i]In order to resolve some issues involving cases where the player’s combatant places tokens on the enemy board, and the enemy’s combatant placing tokens on their board, we’ve reworked PVP combatants to only place tokens on their own side. This affects Sludge Captain and Brightmage.[/i]

[*][b]Brightmage[/b] reworked. At the start of combat, and every 8 seconds after, all enemies are Ignited for 3 seconds.
[i]The immunity to Ignite was added to offset your Units walking into the Ember tokens, but it turned out to be strong enough to be an entire combat modifier effect itself. This new version keeps the general theme but without the side effects.[/i][/list]

[h3]New PvP Perk Pools[/h3]

Two new Perk Pools have been added to PvP! 
[list]
[*][b]Shrine Mage[/b] - The Shrine Mage deals in niche Skillbooks, the same found in the PvE Guild Hall event. Each stage offers two Skillbooks, advancing in power the later in the run you approach him. If you don’t find an offering that fits your current build, the third option for each level is a more generically useful choice.

[*][b]Rhapsody[/b] - The resident Tournament Bard deals in a wide variety of benefits, but often not one that will fit your exact current build as it stands. Pivoting is their specialty! You might find Skillbooks, Mythic units, or passive power that requires different compositions or positioning.[/list]

[h3]Custom Lobby Mode[/h3]

You can now create [b]Custom Lobbies[/b] to play with your friends (or foes)! Custom Lobby works, for the most part, like regular PvP, however all players will need to reach the same step before the lobby advances. For example, everyone in the lobby will configure their army loadout, then click Fight, but then wait until all other players have also clicked Fight. Then, players will be matched against each other randomly, and all battles will need to conclude before all players are sent to the next Preparation phase.

The host of the lobby can kick players and transfer host authority, in the case someone needs to drop out or a player has abandoned the game. If the host abandons the game without transferring to a new host, this will currently cause the lobby to not be able to be finished.

This feature uses a much more involved set of network operations, and as such may be a little more bug prone, so if you do encounter issues, please let us know through the in-game bug reporter and be as thorough as you can with details.


[h1][b]Tuning & Polish[/b][/h1]

[h3]Units[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Monty[/b]: “Special Stats” now includes -10 Attack Speed.
[i]Monty’s been a little too good of a ranged carry thanks to that unlimited Attack Range. It needed a small additional penalty in exchange for that passive, and we didn’t want to hit the skill any more as it’s already not terribly strong.[/i]

[*][b]Lurch[/b]: Starting Mana buffed: 0/110 -> 30/110.
[i]This should ensure Lurch gets at least one of those massive powerhouse casts off, making him a slightly more valued pick.[/i]

[*][b]Vex[/b]: Hex duration reduced: 5 seconds -> 4 seconds. Damage slightly increased, 50 -> 60.
Vex has been providing a little too much utility and shutdown power for enemy casters.

[*][b]Deadhead[/b]: Mana buffed: 40/80 -> 20/60. In addition, Deadhead now gains his bonus Mana if the target dies for any reason while casting, not only if slain by his specific Spell Damage.
[i]While Deadhead has had carry potential, there’s been too large of a vector between chaining casts and non-chained casts. These changes should help with that - we’ll continue to keep an eye on Deadhead’s effectiveness after these changes.[/i]

[*][b]Spindleton[/b]: Reworked. Skill now deals Physical damage once instead of Spell damage over time. Spindleton has a new passive which grants bonus Attack Speed when attacking Hobbled or Slowed targets.
[i]Spindleton has been one of the major outliers in the Unit pool for some time as a unit whose Skill didn’t synergize with its Archetype. Why was an Attacker using solely spell damage and CC? Now, Spindleton should work as a potential AD carry and even open up a potential Hobble setup alongside Grundy. [/i]

[*][b]Lightwing[/b]: Power slightly reduced. 200 Damage / 100 Shield -> 180 Damage / 90 Shield.
[i]See Fae Trait section - trading some Lightwing power into Fae Trait.[/i]

[*][b]Nimbus[/b]: Attack speed bonus while skill active reduced to 30 (from 40).
[i]Slightly overperforming.[/i]

[*][b]Wolfgang[/b]: Armor gain when transforming reduced: 15 -> 10. Max Mana increased: 90 -> 100.
[i]Wolfgang has been a standout unit for his ability to crush teams as both a backliner, a frontliner, a burst source and a tank. His skill has been too all-round; removing some Armor and increasing the time stuck as an archer should help, and a Max Mana increase also increases time to the next rush.[/i]

[*][b]Turbo[/b]: Damage Reduction reduced to 50% (was 60%).
[i]Slightly overbuilt; also the unit that benefits the most from the changes to Bug II as a tank.[/i]

[*][b]Khepri[/b]: Max Mana increased to 85 (was 80).
[i]Khepri was overperforming slightly; however, a bugfix regarding the bonus damage’s duration will also be hitting his power, so only a tiny amount of change was done for this patch.[/i]

[*]Gale: Max Mana increased to 90 (was 70). Starting Mana increased by 20 to match.
[i]Heavily overperforming as an attack carry due to having an extremely powerful skill alongside ideal attack-carry traits. Adding some extra Mana cost should allow enemy teams to better take down Gale before she becomes a tornado once again.[/i]

[*][b]Spiritfang[/b]: Damage and healing per Spectral Sword increased to 80 (was 75).
[i]Slight buff to a relatively awkward unit. We’re still happy with Spiritfang’s identity as a leeching SP-wanting Vanguard, but the lack of scaling means that a little more power is needed. This is a small buff, but it does add up since multiple swords are launched.[/i][/list]

[h3]Traits[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Scrapper Trait[/b]: Combo hit slightly reduced: 10% of Max HP -> 8%.
[i]Scrappers have been just a little too consistently above average across the board. Not by much, but just enough to try to prevent the next “post-Marksman/Dweller” meta being instantly the Scrapper meta.[/i]

[*][b]Beast Trait[/b]: Frenzy slightly reduced: 20 Attack Speed -> 15. Stage II’s Bite damage reduced to 250% of Attack Damage (was 300%).
[i]Beast Stage I has been a little too potent being both a very good global as well as a sizable stat buff for Beasts. Stage II, in addition, has been completely dominating Multiplayer at higher ranks where the massive hits of the stage II Bite is compounded with other damage-increase effects to oneshot foes with basic attacks. A slight touch to both sides will hopefully mean Beast is no longer top tier.[/i]

[*][b]Marksman Trait[/b]: Stage I Damage Amp reduced to 10% (from 15%). Stage II Arrow shots reduced to 80% AD & SP (from 100%), and bonus Range reduced to +1 (from +3). Additionally, Stunned or otherwise incapacitated Marksmen will no longer fire their Arrow.
[i]Marksman II has been a standout strong trait since the stage II rework. The Range reduction in particular is a sizable change to their ability to destroy enemy carries, because the Marksmen would often stick to the special arrow target and continue to auto attack them down. That is still possible, but requires positioning the Marksmen unit closer to the front, putting them at higher risk of taking splash damage from AoEs. In addition to these changes, a larger blanket fix to special Trait and Item effects targeting Invisible units should allow for a few more counters with items such as Invisibility effects. In addition, Marksman I has been noted as slightly overpowered; the Dummy’s utility power was overwhelmed by the amount of Damage Amp provided by the trait. Reining in both sides will help Marksmen needing items to reach their full power.[/i]

[*][b]Fae Trait[/b]: Mana Fairy slightly buffed: 20 Spell Power -> 30.
[i]Fae is just performing a tad low overall, mostly being carried by Lightwing shenanigans. We’re trading some Lightwing power into the Fae trait itself.[/i]

[*][b]Dweller Trait[/b]: Damage Resistance removed from Stage I. Stage II now grants Geogukk 20% Damage Amp.
[i]Dwellers received this Damage Resistance buff to give the Units themselves something to look forward to instead of Geogukk getting all the Trait’s power, but Geo’s targeting and skill have since improved and running the trait main has been exceptionally good. We’ve found that Stage II is frequently employed, but fewer armies opt to move to Stage II, so adding Damage Amp will hopefully allow Geogukk to participate better in lategame combats where his stats are just a little outpaced currently.[/i]

[*][b]Reptile Trait[/b]: Most stats slightly reduced. Attack speed unchanged, Lifesteal slightly increased. Elder Reto’s bonus changed from Mana Regen to Starting Mana (20). Stage II grants Reptile units an additional +100% of their specific value (500% total).
[i]Reto’s 2 Mana Regen was a little too much, but a nerf to 1 would be too much of one. Mana Regen therefore isn’t a suitable stat for this since it has too small of values to be tunable, so we replaced it with Starting Mana. The general power level for a given Reptile buff has proven to be suitable at around 80% of a Component’s power, so we’ve balanced the stats around that general benchmark. Stage II was slightly underbuilt, so we’ve given it another shock of power to hopefully inject more play.[/i]

[*][b]Bug Trait[/b]: Stage II Swarm damage changed from a flat 75 damage to 3% of the struck foes’ Max Health.
[i]An almost unplayable trait due to dealing extremely low flat damage late into the game, when units have thousands of health. Now, Bug II should be a much stronger, deadly late game trait that can shred units down in seconds.[/i]

[*][b]Orc Trait[/b]: Stage II bonus Damage Resist buffed: 30% Damage Resist -> 35%.
[i]Slightly underbuilt and low impact - this should help Orc carries stay alive just a little longer when Stage II is active.[/i]

[*][b]Mythic Trait[/b]: Valor slightly buffed: 10% Damage Amp and Resist -> 12%. Mana Regen granted to Mythics in Mythic II buffed: 4 Mana Regen -> 6.
[i]Slightly underused, particularly in Multiplayer. In particular, this change is angled towards improving the success of strategies that use two or more Mythics, where the Valor stacking means this change is more impactful and the Mana Regen goes much further.[/i]

[*][b]Elemental Trait[/b]: Stage II now grants 500 Max Health (was 400).
[i]Slight adjustment to improve play rate.[/i]

[*][b]Horror Trait[/b]: Horrifying Tentacles created by Stage II now have the stats of an Uncommon unit (was Common).
[i]Tentacles typically spawned and then immediately died without contributing much to the fight. By having more health and slightly more damage, this should notably improve their power and mean more Horror II builds.[/i]

[*][b]Treefolk Trait[/b]: Treefolk II now causes Treefolk to start combat with two additional stacks of Sprout.
[i]Slightly underbuilt; in addition, the proliferation of Ignite has meant permanent Regen as a Stage II is unsatisfying, particularly in Multiplayer. Adding some pure stat value should mean the Regen is more powerful and the trait is more enticing.[/i] [/list]

[h3]Items[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Magicannon Equipment[/b]: Now applies Shock. Shock does nothing at first, but after ten hits, all Shock is consumed to deal a gargantuan 250 Spell Damage (increased by Spell Power)!
[i]Magicannon was an underbuilt equipment, as on-Hit units and Attack Speed carries often had better uses for the item slot. Now, there should be additional excitement, increased power and more output from increasing Spell Power on its owners.[/i]

[*][b]Emergency Chicken Equipment[/b]: Now Stifles all enemies within 2 hexes for 5 seconds when the Chicken spawns.
[i]Low usage rate, similar to Magicannon - in addition, Stifle was underrepresented in the item pool. This should make Emergency Chicken a little more of a burst counter. Stifling the enemy team means the Chicken provides more utility than just being a damage soak distraction.[/i]

[*][b]Wicked Khopesh[/b] renamed and rethemed to Wicked Slasher. 
[i]To avoid confusion with the new Scythe items, which have a similar shape and theme.[/i]

[*][b]Spiked Gauntlets Equipment[/b]: Reworked. “The first time the wearer attacks each enemy in each combat, deal +100% damage, interrupt, and Shred for 5 seconds.”
[i]While this item had been performing fine, it provides too much variance to combats, particularly in the context of PVP - fights could be lost or won by crit RNG in ways that are ultimately not healthy for the game. Spiked Gauntlets should still remain a powerful choice for Attack carries that plan to burst down each enemy in the opponent’s team, it just does so in a more consistent manner.[/i]

[*][b]Shock Pendant Equipment[/b]: Now triggers 12 times total per combat (from 15).
[i]Small adjustment to make the item slightly less potent in late game combats, it has been slightly over performing for tank Equipment, particularly when building multiple of them.[/i]

[*][b]Superior Spear Equipment[/b]: Minor buff, 25% AD -> 30%
[i]Small adjustment to bump the item’s usage up a little.[/i]

[*][b]Edan’s Blade Equipment[/b]: Now grants 15 Mana.
[i]Slight adjustment to buff the item’s build rate and make it a little more tempting for Burst Caster carries.[/i]

[*][b]Orb of Everything[/b]: No longer adds Lifesteal. 
[i]This item was a little overperforming and Lifesteal is now the Scythe’s domain.[/i][/list]

[h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Morphling Unit[/b]: Can now only field one Morphling.
[i]The original intention of Morphling was to get a duplicate unit that counted for Traits, but without a restriction such as this, it became too easy to put in a single unit surrounded by Morphlings and reach multiple Tier 2 traits with ease.[/i] [/list]

The SneakyTeak special community code perk now increases non-free Reroll costs by 2 SP.

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a major issue that was causing many sources of Shred to reduce Armor to 0 instead of by 50%.
[*]Fixed a frame-perfect input that would cause a Unit to become “stuck to your hand”, not releasing when letting go of left click. This would have been more visible and apparent on players running on lower FPS but was possible to see at 60 FPS.
[*]Fixed Abandon Ship causing the same issue as above if you currently had a unit held and being dragged the moment an automatic sell was happening elsewhere.
[*]Fixed a great deal of issues where game content would pull up keywords that weren't actually used.
[*]Fixed several issues where units wouldn't trigger their On Cast procs.
[*]Fixed a variety of game typos or incorrect text in-game.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Adaptive Scrappers perk granted SP instead of the intended Attack Speed.
[*]Fixed an issue where units could instantaneously balloon to 400 Attack Speed using certain item combinations.
[*]Fixed issues with some units having no Recommended Items.
[*]Fixed issues where Aquatic 2 wasn’t dealing damage to enemies.
[*]Fixed issues where debug visual effects persisted into gameplay when using the Bug and Ghoul traits.
[*]Fixed issues with pre-combat warnings getting disabled if the Tutorial was ran in the same session.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Triple Wielding bonus had no effect.
[*]Fixed an issue where, in certain situations, units Ignited by Magma hexes would still heal normally.
[*]Fixed a rare issue where event rooms could cause Devil’s Deal prompts.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Fusion Gem consumable’s results didn’t respect unlocks (could grant a Ring-merged item even with Ring disabled)
[*]Fixed an issue where items purchased in the shop would continue to ban that item for all future rerolls in the same shop instance, instead of only for the next reroll in that shop.
[*]Fixed an issue where many ‘special effects’ such as arrows from Marksman II could target Invisible enemies or foes in Stasis.
[*]Fixed an issue where Willow’s skill would only deal damage to foes in a 1-hex radius (was intended to be 2-hex).
[*]Fixed many difficulty options being missing from Custom difficulty mode.
[*]Fixed Custom difficulty mode buttons having an incredibly small hitbox to mouse over to read the effects of the difficulty setting.
[*]Fixed an issue where a blue debug box could be rendered on the UI in some cases (usually only spotted when the main menu first loads)
[*]Fixed Magnetic Remover being able to be used on a Unit with no items, consuming it.
[*]Fixed several specialty traits like the Hydra’s head effect appearing in the Compendium.
[*]Rebuilt Run History logic such that it can be generated when abandoning a run from the main menu.
[*]Fixed Run History errors related to PVP (sometimes not showing the Rank)
[*]Fixed a damage calculation issue with Wanderbot’s skill that could cause it to to get astronomical damage numbers with the right setups.
[*]Fixed Gob Barker missing a keyword link for ‘Traps’.
[*]Compendium, when viewed in the Main Menu, now shows all Unit Bonus Traits. When viewing in a run, it still will only show active Bonus Traits.
[*]Fixed Instant Start button not remembering if your last chosen character was Random.
[*]Fixed Reptile’s Lifesteal bonus only lasting for the first combat a given Unit participated in.
[*]Fixed an issue with Skillbook: Mana Battery not properly distributing mana among allied units.
[*]Fixed an issue where Stifle was not considered Crowd Control by some effects.
[*]Fixed Withervine Potion not being usable against enemies immune to Crowd Control.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Shop idle VO lines would trigger immediately on entering a shop instead of being properly delayed.
[*]Fixed an issue where, when loading a run, any slots in the Unit Store that were cursed will re-trigger a Doom increment.
[*]Fixed an issue where loading a run could load the stored Doom value twice, resulting in doubling it.
[*]Fixed an issue with Unit targeting regarding tiebreakers, which could cause inconsistency when picking between two adjacent, in-range Units. [i](thanks to Naelhinn and csdavis for some extremely specific case testing to find this issue)[/i]
[*]Fixed an issue where PVP fight sends were not including Item data beyond the 3rd slot.
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing Khepri’s bonus damage from his Skill to last 25% longer than intended.
[*]Fixed self-damage effects triggering Lifesteal.
[*]Fixed another issue that could cause Shred-O-Matic to leave Stasis before its Conduits are destroyed.
[*]Fixed an issue with the Golden Desert region modifier that could cause units already Stunned to be permastunned when hit by the Twister.
[*]Fixed an issue with Morphling that could cause the unit it was copying to become banished if Morphling themselves tiers up to tier 4, instead of banishing Morphling.
[*]Fixed an issue that could cause a Unit, if it targeted a Unit on the first moment of combat who then immediately when invisible or died on the same frame, to get stuck and be unable to target any other units for the rest of combat.
[*]Fixed Mage-Hand Hurl skill grabbing two friendly units instead of the declared 1 unit.
[*]Fixed a bug that was causing Flash’s Skill hitboxes to be absurdly tiny, causing them to miss many enemies.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed certain combats with the Museum Curator combatant to allow it to have one more unit than intended.[list]

tags.feature: A new Unlock has been added, which adds a brand new Component item! The Scythe increases Lifesteal at its base, and as a component item, it merges with every other component into a brand new item.

Shapeshifter & Taskmaster: Now present their Banners during the character selection process, but it replaces a component.
Sludge Captain: Now places the Mud tokens in your front two columns, but also makes your team immune to Hobbled and Shredded.
Brightmage reworked. At the start of combat, and every 8 seconds after, all enemies are Ignited for 3 seconds.

tags.feature: Two new Perk Pools have been added to PvP!
Shrine Mage - The Shrine Mage deals in niche Skillbooks, the same found in the PvE Guild Hall event.
Rhapsody - The resident Tournament Bard deals in a wide variety of benefits, but often not one that will fit your exact current build as it stands.
You can now create Custom Lobbies to play with your friends (or foes)!

tags.balance_change: Monty: “Special Stats” now includes -10 Attack Speed.
Lurch: Starting Mana buffed: 0/110 -> 30/110.
Vex: Hex duration reduced: 5 seconds -> 4 seconds. Damage slightly increased, 50 -> 60.
Deadhead: Mana buffed: 40/80 -> 20/60. In addition, Deadhead now gains his bonus Mana if the target dies for any reason while casting, not only if slain by his specific Spell Damage.
Spindleton: Reworked. Skill now deals Physical damage once instead of Spell damage over time. Spindleton has a new passive which grants bonus Attack Speed when attacking Hobbled or Slowed targets.
Lightwing: Power slightly reduced. 200 Damage / 100 Shield -> 180 Damage / 90 Shield.
Nimbus: Attack speed bonus while skill active reduced to 30 (from 40).
Wolfgang: Armor gain when transforming reduced: 15 -> 10. Max Mana increased: 90 -> 100.
Turbo: Damage Reduction reduced to 50% (was 60%).
Khepri: Max Mana increased to 85 (was 80).
Gale: Max Mana increased to 90 (was 70). Starting Mana increased by 20 to match.
Spiritfang: Damage and healing per Spectral Sword increased to 80 (was 75).
Scrapper Trait: Combo hit slightly reduced: 10% of Max HP -> 8%.
Beast Trait: Frenzy slightly reduced: 20 Attack Speed -> 15. Stage II’s Bite damage reduced to 250% of Attack Damage (was 300%).

Marksman Trait: Stage I Damage Amp reduced to 10% (from 15%). Stage II Arrow shots reduced to 80% AD & SP (from 100%), and bonus Range reduced to +1 (from +3). Additionally, Stunned or otherwise incapacitated Marksmen will no longer fire their Arrow.
Fae Trait: Mana Fairy slightly buffed: 20 Spell Power -> 30.
Dweller Trait: Damage Resistance removed from Stage I. Stage II now grants Geogukk 20% Damage Amp.

Reptile Trait: Most stats slightly reduced. Attack speed unchanged, Lifesteal slightly increased. Elder Reto’s bonus changed from Mana Regen to Starting Mana (20). Stage II grants Reptile units an additional +100% of their specific value (500% total).
Bug Trait: Stage II Swarm damage changed from a flat 75 damage to 3% of the struck foes’ Max Health.
Orc Trait: Stage II bonus Damage Resist buffed: 30% Damage Resist -> 35%.
Mythic Trait: Valor slightly buffed: 10% Damage Amp and Resist -> 12%. Mana Regen granted to Mythics in Mythic II buffed: 4 Mana Regen -> 6.
Elemental Trait: Stage II now grants 500 Max Health (was 400).
Horror Trait: Horrifying Tentacles created by Stage II now have the stats of an Uncommon unit (was Common).
Treefolk Trait: Treefolk II now causes Treefolk to start combat with two additional stacks of Sprout.
Magicannon Equipment: Now applies Shock. Shock does nothing at first, but after ten hits, all Shock is consumed to deal a gargantuan 250 Spell Damage (increased by Spell Power)!
Emergency Chicken Equipment: Now Stifles all enemies within 2 hexes for 5 seconds when the Chicken spawns.
Wicked Khopesh renamed and rethemed to Wicked Slasher.
Spiked Gauntlets Equipment: Reworked. “The first time the wearer attacks each enemy in each combat, deal +100% damage, interrupt, and Shred for 5 seconds.”
Shock Pendant Equipment: Now triggers 12 times total per combat (from 15).
Superior Spear Equipment: Minor buff, 25% AD -> 30%
Edan’s Blade Equipment: Now grants 15 Mana.
Orb of Everything: No longer adds Lifesteal.
Morphling Unit: Can now only field one Morphling.
The SneakyTeak special community code perk now increases non-free Reroll costs by 2 SP.

tags.bug: Fixed a major issue that was causing many sources of Shred to reduce Armor to 0 instead of by 50%.
Fixed a frame-perfect input that would cause a Unit to become “stuck to your hand”, not releasing when letting go of left click.
Fixed Abandon Ship causing the same issue as above if you currently had a unit held and being dragged the moment an automatic sell was happening elsewhere.
Fixed a great deal of issues where game content would pull up keywords that weren't actually used.
Fixed several issues where units wouldn't trigger their On Cast procs.
Fixed a variety of game typos or incorrect text in-game.
Fixed a bug where the Adaptive Scrappers perk granted SP instead of the intended Attack Speed.
Fixed an issue where units could instantaneously balloon to 400 Attack Speed using certain item combinations.
Fixed issues with some units having no Recommended Items.
Fixed issues where Aquatic 2 wasn’t dealing damage to enemies.
Fixed issues where debug visual effects persisted into gameplay when using the Bug and Ghoul traits.
Fixed issues with pre-combat warnings getting disabled if the Tutorial was ran in the same session.
Fixed an issue where the Triple Wielding bonus had no effect.
Fixed an issue where, in certain situations, units Ignited by Magma hexes would still heal normally.
Fixed a rare issue where event rooms could cause Devil’s Deal prompts.
Fixed an issue where the Fusion Gem consumable’s results didn’t respect unlocks (could grant a Ring-merged item even with Ring disabled)
Fixed an issue where items purchased in the shop would continue to ban that item for all future rerolls in the same shop instance, instead of only for the next reroll in that shop.
Fixed an issue where many ‘special effects’ such as arrows from Marksman II could target Invisible enemies or foes in Stasis.
Fixed an issue where Willow’s skill would only deal damage to foes in a 1-hex radius (was intended to be 2-hex).
Fixed many difficulty options being missing from Custom difficulty mode.
Fixed Custom difficulty mode buttons having an incredibly small hitbox to mouse over to read the effects of the difficulty setting.
Fixed an issue where a blue debug box could be rendered on the UI in some cases (usually only spotted when the main menu first loads)
Fixed Magnetic Remover being able to be used on a Unit with no items, consuming it.
Fixed several specialty traits like the Hydra’s head effect appearing in the Compendium.
Rebuilt Run History logic such that it can be generated when abandoning a run from the main menu.
Fixed Run History errors related to PVP (sometimes not showing the Rank)
Fixed a damage calculation issue with Wanderbot’s skill that could cause it to to get astronomical damage numbers with the right setups.
Fixed Gob Barker missing a keyword link for ‘Traps’.
Compendium, when viewed in the Main Menu, now shows all Unit Bonus Traits. When viewing in a run, it still will only show active Bonus Traits.
Fixed Instant Start button not remembering if your last chosen character was Random.
Fixed Reptile’s Lifesteal bonus only lasting for the first combat a given Unit participated in.
Fixed an issue with Skillbook: Mana Battery not properly distributing mana among allied units.
Fixed an issue where Stifle was not considered Crowd Control by some effects.
Fixed Withervine Potion not being usable against enemies immune to Crowd Control.
Fixed an issue where the Shop idle VO lines would trigger immediately on entering a shop instead of being properly delayed.
Fixed an issue where, when loading a run, any slots in the Unit Store that were cursed will re-trigger a Doom increment.
Fixed an issue where loading a run could load the stored Doom value twice, resulting in doubling it.
Fixed an issue with Unit targeting regarding tiebreakers, which could cause inconsistency when picking between two adjacent, in-range Units.
Fixed an issue where PVP fight sends were not including Item data beyond the 3rd slot.
Fixed an issue that was causing Khepri’s bonus damage from his Skill to last 25% longer than intended.
Fixed self-damage effects triggering Lifesteal.
Fixed another issue that could cause Shred-O-Matic to leave Stasis before its Conduits are destroyed.
Fixed an issue with the Golden Desert region modifier that could cause units already Stunned to be permastunned when hit by the Twister.
Fixed an issue with Morphling that could cause the unit it was copying to become banished if Morphling themselves tiers up to tier 4, instead of banishing Morphling.

Fixed an issue that could cause a Unit, if it targeted a Unit on the first moment of combat who then immediately when invisible or died on the same frame, to get stuck and be unable to target any other units for the rest of combat.
Fixed Mage-Hand Hurl skill grabbing two friendly units instead of the declared 1 unit.
Fixed a bug that was causing Flash’s Skill hitboxes to be absurdly tiny, causing them to miss many enemies.
Fixed a bug that allowed certain combats with the Museum Curator combatant to allow it to have one more unit than intended.

notes.title: Small Balance Update v1.0.61
notes.content:
Gourmand's bonus Attack after eating the donut now deals triple damage (from double).

Torque's skill has been changed: Torque now heals for 150 and the cone deals 75 Spell Damage and Ignites for 4 seconds. Spell Power scaling changed to the healing and damage rather than scaling the Ignite duration. This should make Torque slightly more of a generalist rather than depending entirely on Ignite.

Baa'lor summons now enter combat with 500 Shield base (from 400).

Oakengard's skill now heals itself and adjacent allies for 150 (from 120).

Willow's final burst while casting now deals 300 Spell Damage (from 200).

Lurch is now a genius and smartly targets as many foes as possible every time. (This is a sizable buff despite not changing any numbers!)

Deadhead now deals 250 Spell damage (from 220).

Ragno now casts on itself if no other allies are available. Shield granted increased to 200 (from 150).

Button spores now deal 100 Spell Damage per hit (from 70).

Mawrice now gains an extra +20 Attack Speed while buffed.

Teak shield explosions now deal 200% of Teak's Attack Damage (from 150%).

Sir Sparkles now heals for 55 Health per second (from 50). Since it hits two targets for a duration on each, this is still a sizable buff.

Ivy's Stumpy summon now inherits Ivy's Tier! Go forth, Stumpy enthusiasts, and may the Tier 4 Stumpies be plentiful!

Morita physical damage dealt increased to 175% of Attack Damage (from 150). Spell Damage dealt on collision increased to 175 (from 150).

Zwei max mana reduced to 40 (from 50). This should make getting extra stacks of Life Ender Blade more achievable.

Tinker Mana changed to 60/75 (was 80/100).

Volcanus spin attacks now deal 85% Attack Damage (from 75).

Sanctus now heals for 170 (from 150).

Tidus' main Tidal Wave now deals 200 Spell Damage (from 150).
Porcino's Arrow now deals 160 Spell Damage (from 120).

Skul's Shield Bash damage increased to 120 (was 100).

Fritz Mana changed to 45/90 (was 55/100).

Corvid's Knives embedded in the target now detonate for 90 Spell Damage (was 70).

Deshret Mana changed to 60/120 (was 80/140).

Rime Spell Damage increased to 180 (from 150). Stun duration increased to 1.25 seconds (from 1 second).

Shelly Max Mana now 60 (from 75).

Noctus no longer Stifles all foes for 3 seconds when casting - instead applies Stifle on-hit with the skill.

Uro has been heavily nerfed. Self heal percentage and damage over time both reduced to 2.5% max Health (from 4%).

Additional casts of Wolfgang's rush after transforming now cost 130 Mana (from 90).

Glitter now deals 280 Spell Damage to foes returning from sheepification (from 300).

Demon now grants 10% Damage Amp to all Demons in addition to its previous effects.

Healer II Shrine now gains 70% of the team's healed Health in Charge (from 80%).

Marksman I's Dummy now gains Max HP at the start of combat rather than a Shield, making it easier to gauge the current status of your Dummy.

Marksman II has been reworked. Now grants all Marksmen +3 Attack Range and causes them to retarget to the highest damage foe every 3 seconds while firing the same powerful shot. This should cement their status as focus firing squadrons that can absolutely take down enemy carries.

Orb of Everything changed. Now grants +10% Lifesteal, Damage Amp and Damage Resist, as well as immunity to Hobble, Shred, Stifle and Ignite.

New Item on offer in the Oasis Merchant event: Ponderer's Stone. Discover it yourself in the Oasis in your next run!

Vex's skill duration properly reduced to 4 seconds. The previous nerf had not actually reduced Vex's duration. We'll still continue to keep an eye on Vex after this update, but we didn't want to add a nerf onto a nerf that hadn't taken place yet. 

Shock Pendant buffed, 6% -> 8% Max HP damage

Edan's Blade buffed, 15% -> 20% Damage Amp

Vanguard's Helm buffed, 10 -> 15 flat damage reduction

Magicannon buffed, 20 -> 25 damage on hit

Cleaver buffed, 2.5% -> 3% attack damage / HP

Mallet of Mashing nerfed, 10% -> 5% Max HP damage

All Ignite sources buffed, 1.5% -> 2% max HP damage

Demon Trait numbers adjusted, 50 Attack Speed 75 Spell Power -> 40 Attack Speed 50 Spell Power

Vex nerfed by way of Shaman II change - now only affects Stun and Sheep effects rather than all crowd control (this was the original intent, and why Vex received a stun in the first place) 

Bug 2 now causes the Swarm to deal aoe magic damage over time rather than gaining bonus stats when the Swarm moves.

Brawler 2 Stomp reduced to 3% (from 4%) max HP damage.

Dweller 1 Damage Resist reduced to 10% (from 15%).

Elemental now grants a small flat health bonus to Elementals in addition to its current effect. 

Fixed an issue where Ragno wasn't triggering on-cast procs such as Wand of Missiles.

Fixed an issue where some ranged Legends would be placed in the frontline when facing opponents in PVP.

Fixed an issue where the Triple Wielding perk wasn't granting its stats.

notes.title: Update 22 (redeploy) v1.0.55
notes.content:
Redeployed Update 22 with an exploit resolved, and with additional bug fixes:

Fixed an issue where Enlightened Gourmand was gaining triple the (non-permanent) Maximum Health each cast.

Fixed an issue where Item Icons would duplicate at various times, particularly when merging Component Items.

Fixed an issue where Devil's Deals with Museum Curator or Tabletop Tactician combat modifiers would have more or less units than intended, leading to more difficult or easy fights. (Fix failed from a previous update.)

Fixed an issue where Trollgar could spawn Shadow Clones when in non-Boss encounters where that effect wasn't supposed to be active.

Fixed a longstanding issue where the Twin Primes Specialization perk did nothing.

Fixed an issue where sharing Divine Blessings with the Ascension perk wasn't functioning.

Added safeguards to prevent an issue where Match Card Events could be skipped after loading the game.

Fixed a longstanding issue where River could sometimes grant her Army a Trait they already had in the Rival combat.

Fixed multiple issues where units could become stuck on the Mouse Cursor when alt-tabbing.

notes.title: 1.0 Update 22 (v1.0.53)
notes.content:
Vex debuff duration reduced to 4 seconds (from 5)

Shaman II duration modifier reduced to 50% (from 100%)

Crosby skill damage reduced to 275 (from 300)

4 more Tiers have been added, specifically for use with various Tier-break items and effects. Go wild with your Moon Blessing'd Double-Royal Dragon.

Fixed an exploit in Ranked PVP involving rating losses.

Fixed a rare specific AI logic bug issue that would occur if there is only one allied unit and one enemy unit left on the board, which could cause both Units to not consider each other valid, softlocking the fight.

Added text to the Ritual Dagger for the Blood trait to clarify the Unit must be in play in order to be sacrificed (as you can technically Prepare a Unit, then Bench it, but this stops the sacrifice from working)

Fixed PVP Elvish Empowerment stating the wrong stats in the tooltip when hovering the hex itself.

Blook now secretly clears crowd control on arrival and prevents crowd control to the possessed Unit, which very rarely happened anyway but could result in some odd AI behavior.

Fixed CC cleanse effects not clearing Taunt.

Fixed Slogurk's Crystal passive (mana on cast) when combined with the Scare Tactics ability granting mana regen to its skill target, not itself.

Fixed Slogurk not gaining benefits from the Elemental trait when one of its core selected Traits was Elemental

Removed an old restriction that fully prevented you from starting a fight if you have no Units, as this could technically softlock if you spend all SP without buying a unit.

Fixed a rare issue when loading a run while a unit is equipped with the Cloning Capsule that could cause the capsule to trigger during the load and generate a new unit.

Fixed an issue where Trollgar (boss form) could create more illusion clones than intended.

Fixed a PVP-related issue where if you played against an opponent with +1 item slots, all future opponents would have the UI for 4 item slots (though would not utilize them, as this was a loading display issue only, not resetting the unit slots back to 3 after that fight) 

Fixed Run History not loading Ranked run state properly (said all PVP runs were Unranked)

Fixed Lodestones counting towards 'item power' army total calculations

Fixed Tier 6 units not counting towards 'unit power' army total calculations

Re-fixed Devil's Deals with Museum Curator / Tabletop Tactician cancelling their army size modifier.

Fixed Cosmic Matter causing Tier Ups beyond 4. Only the Moon Blessing specifically calls out the ability to do this.

Added a safeguard to auto-release a Unit if the user left clicks while a Unit is already in hand. This should be impossible, but we've seen a handful of rare reports that it can happen. Seems to possibly be related to leaving the game window while a unit is in hand.

Fixed Privileged Position not adding the extra bonus units to the pool as it said it did.

Additional Chinese localization polish

notes.title: 1.0 Update 21 (v1.0.50)
notes.content:
Fixed a major issue where the rewards granted from Champions would be the rewards of the Champion you didn't choose. This also led to potentially having the same Champion as a Rival and an Ally, causing further issues later on.

Fester's healing per second reduced to 4% (from 5%). Fester's skill has been noted by many players as an outlier among the Common units. By offering Damage Reduction, healing and AOE it covers more bases than most - reducing the self-heal should make Fester need a bit more itemization.

Pyro Kit damage and Shield reduced to 20% (from 25%). Small tap to Tactican tier strategies focusing on max-HP payoffs; generally speaking, Max HP values are higher than when Pyro Kit was set to its 25% values.

Fixed an issue where Compendium Trait entries would display sources of bonus Trait pips from your previous runs in the same session.

Fixed an issue where the original copy of items duplicated by the Blood trait would disappear after being used. 

Potential fix for an issue where spamming things that can summon the Speech Bubble rapidly could break the Speech Bubble for the rest of the session.

Potential fix for the rare issue where the 'flyer rod' piece appears on non-flying units.

notes.title: 1.0 Update 19 (v1.0.49)
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where your PVP Combat Modifier wouldn't update when loading back into the game to reflect increases to Army Size and Store Rarity.

Fixed an issue where it was possible to duplicate items with certain Slogurk setups.

Fixed an issue where Xanatos was not gaining the intended Mana when slaying a foe with his Skill.

PVP combats will no longer send to the server or load if they had 2 fewer units than the maximum Army Size.

Fixed a typo with the Infusion perk stating it granted less Mana Regen than intended.

Fixed Gale's skill description not triggering the keyword for On Hit

Not sure how one report showed a die result of 0, but added as a safeguard should that ever happen.

Fixed Summoning Shard not properly interacting with a transformed Morphling

Fixed Trait tooltips potentially bleeding past the bottom edge of the screen, for larger Trait tooltips that happen to be at the bottom of the left-side Trait list.

Fixed an exploit related to Skull of Hedra and running duplicate units

Fixed the Geogukk statue not being right-clickable to preview stats

Fixed Xanatos not creating floating damage numbers

Potential fix for a rare 'lost my Hydra snack' issue.

Fixed Hydra Snacks not having item icons, and were just using the Hydra's character icon (which caused it to have a white background when hovered)

Fixed Hydra missing all VFX attachment point sockets

Clarified Wolfgang's text that he rushes to his skill target even when already transformed (effectively a jump). Adjusted Wolfgang's skill visuals to help clarify this mechanic with a slightly altered animation which has him running for a few frames, and an animated trail towards where he came from when moving far distances.

Fixed an issue where the Weavery (extra enemy banners) challenge climb modifier did not affect the first 2 combats of Act 2 and 3, resulting in those acts being easier than intended in Challenge Climb.

Skeleton revival no longer counts as Healing for purposes of floating numbers, combat recap, Healer trait effects, etc.

Champion Tales now display their rewards at the champion choice phase, rather than only after choosing a champion.

Fixed most Ignite effects not tracking to the Combat Recap

Fixed Engineer Turret being listed as Uncategorized in the recap.

Fixed Potion Belt giving 1 more potion than listed.

Fixed some minor visual issues on the Factory board - one piece in the back of the table not masking during act transitions, and some of the pieces that travel on the conveyor being too metallic (too shiny)

Fixed UI wrap issue with the Hat panel within the Compendium

Fixed a minor visual issue that could let the Engineer turret keep its supercharge visual across multiple combats/runs, even if the turret is not spawned

notes.title: 1.0 Update 18 Hotfix 1 (v1.0.46)
notes.content:
Fixed Ignite's keyword description not stating it halves healing.

Fixed Overtime's keyword description still saying it increased Damage and Speed rather than Amp.

Fixed Xanatos' encounter generation logic trying to put Runes on Zombies, which can't be equipped.

Fixed minor UI display issue when Army stats gameplay option is on, and the combatant you are facing has the maximum amount of text.

Fixed a hitch at the end of a run, when going from the Unlocks panel, back to the end of run screen.

Excluded dice number faces from being affected by low graphics settings, so they remain clearly visible and not blurred.

When the stat card is currently up for an Elemental, and then the Elemental red number trait effect kicks in, the stat card will update the red value instead of needing to be closed and reopened to see the change.

Fixed Morphling causing certain configuration checks to fail (such as Singrim's Hyperfocus perk, if it was the unit causing a Stage 2 trait to activate)

Fixed Skill Passive effects being retained when equipping a Skillbook.

Fixed a minor UI issue at end of run screen where the 'Total Mastery' label faded in twice

When facing the Arbiter, Trait icons in the sidebars will have an icon over them helping to remind that no trait effects are active.

The Arbiter can no longer appear in a Devil's Deal combat. 

Fixed an issue where Bosses could preemptively be banished when encountering certain combats.

Fixed outdated text descriptions in some cases.

Fixed an issue where the Bounty requiring victory with a Trait wasn't tracking victories with Stage II of a Trait.

Fixed an issue where Kalandre's Mirror didn't function.

Fixed an issue where a Tier 4 Morphling imitating a unit would banish it from the pool.

Fixed an issue where units could gain 100 Armor in rare cases.

Fixed an issue where Deshret couldn't cast on allies. 

Fixed an issue where Gourmand could sometimes (rarely) not trigger on-cast effects like Leechknife sheathe.

When opening the Unlocks screen for the first time, this panel now initializes asyncronously with a 'Loading Unlocks...' text while the panel loads. The Unlocks panel is somewhat expensive to load compared to other panels, and one user reported having crash issues when trying to do so on a lower spec machine. It will be barely noticeable on higher end machines, less than a second before the panel loads.

Colossal Heart now adds a little visual indicator on the army size UI to remind that one of the slots has been occupied by the Heart holder.

Fixed Trait and Unit contracts sometimes losing which Trait or Unit they were connected to on the backend when loading a run, which would cause them to become uncompletable.

Fixed minor UI issue where the current Level could not updated upon levelling.

Removed the "unlock 5 game modifiers" achievement as we don't really clearly have game modifiers any more.

Fixed an exploit related to Abandon Ship 

Fixed an issue where it was impossible to buy free items from Special Shops with negative gold.

Fixed various text issues.

Fixed an issue where the Giving and Receiving Rings had no effects on enemy units.

The Flamemark now has its own Potion Slot rather than needing to open the Inventory Bag each time it's used.

Fixed an issue where Stalkers weren't receiving effects from Blood or Ritual triggers.

Fixed an issue where units right clicked in the Unit Store could appear to have Cost Reduction they didn't actually have.

notes.title: 1.0 Update 16 (v1.0.42)
notes.content:
Fixed exiting the game during Ranked PVP during the starting bundle selection UI causing an invalid save state - the game would save a run without a bundle chosen, resulting in a Ranked run with nothing to start with. Bundles are now saved when generated, and exiting at this point will not save the PVP run, but will save the same bundles and will display them again when next you decide to start a Ranked PVP run.

Fixed an issue where the DM speech bubble popup wouldn't readjust its location after changing resolutions, potentially leading to it being offscreen. This seemed to be more common in Ultrawide resolutions.

Fixed a minor display issue in character selection, if choosing Draft character, then selecting another character.

Fixed a minor UI reset issue where Region effect UI would remain visible in future runs. This was rarely relevant unless doing a PVP run after a PVE run in the same session.

Fixed Geogukk (and other summons) not having River's Basics (and similar condition-triggered effects) applied in PVP.

Tactician rank PVP is now slightly more forgiving, with a range of -20 to +20 rank points earned (0 to 10 wins) - up from -30 to +10. This matches Master rank's rate of progression.

Fixed an issue that could cause the Reroll button to become unusable in the first floor of a PVP run

Fixed an issue that could cause Contracts to not return their reward if turned in exactly when entering a Rest site

Fixed several errors exclusive to Chinese localization

notes.title: 1.0 Update 15 (v1.0.40P)
notes.content:
Tuning & Balance

Brim's final cast now adds 3 double-attacks (down from 5). Bonus spell damage on hit reduced to 30 (from 40).

Kio's mana cost increased to 75 (from 50)

Manaburner item Mana Regen reduced to 10 (from 20). 

Oakengard max mana increased to 60 (up from 50).

Fae's Mana Fairy Spell Power reduced to 20 (from 25).

Mushroom's Starting Mana raised to 40 (from 30), Spell Power per spore reduced to 10 (from 15).

Fixed an issue where Mage's 75% total Spell Power reduction was applying as a flat amount of -25 instead of a percentage of total.

Healer Stage 1 reduced to 25% of healing applied as Shield, down from 33%.

Lightwing Shield reduced to 100 (from 125).

Sir Sparkles healing reduced to 50 (from 60).

Stability Ward damage required to trigger effect increased to 150 (from 100).

Pauldron of Mi'Lo armor proc on low health reduced to 20 (from 30).

Manasoaker 1 mana when hit removed.

PVP Changes

PVP Rarity Costs raised slightly once more, now matching Army Size increases exactly.

PVP Eager Newbie starting SP reduced by 1.

Skye's Crafting 101, and Ki O'dini's Mythic Tale perks will now predetermine and display the reward rather than it being random at the point of clicking. Otto's random Unit perks still remain random, and now state 'random Units' in their texts.

Ki O'dini's Mythic Tale perks updated to offer a more tailored selection of Mythics per rarity. Commons still use the Bonus Mythics pool, but Uncommons now can use some Event Mythics, and Rares can pull from Bosses as well as Ifreyes' special Rare Bonus Mythics.

Ki O'dini's Mythic Tale II (uncommons) now grants 3 Star Points in addition to the Unit.

Gera's Morphology Test now grants a Cosmic Matter instead of a Rainbowslime Vial.

Gera's Underhanded Sources perk has been replaced with Dark Dealings, which grants a Book of Banishment and allows up to 2 more to be purchased from shops.

Bug Fixes & Polish

Altered wording of Skye's Mortar to make the effect more clear

Added Perk preview icons to PVP champion selection screen 

Fixed an issue from Hotfix 14 where the Portable Forge item would destroy non-component items.

Fixed a PVP save timing issue where rerolling would save the run before deducting a free roll, resulting in a roll exploit.

Fixed a PVP save issue where in Unranked play, the item store would change items when returning to the main menu and continuing the run.

Fixed a general save issue when loading into a shop room (which always happens in PVP), the load process would cause the RNG seed to shift.

Fixed a general save issue where Units in the Unit store could change upon returning to the main menu after a save.

Cursed and Tier 2 Unit Store slot states now save & load properly 

Fixed an issue where Instant Start's Last Played functionality only worked when playing multiple runs in the same session.

Fixed an issue where the Unlucky Lass PVP Combat Modifier wouldn't grant its rewards.

Fixed issues regarding placing a Morphling into the Cloning Hex - you can no longer do so.

Fixed an issue where the Museum Curator and Tactician Combat Modifiers wouldn't activate their effects on the enemy side when in a Devil's Deal combat. This could cause some Devil's Deal combats to be easier or more difficult than intended. 

Fixed Vigilant Vessel not functioning with shields

Fixed a very small window during rest sites where units could be picked up and dragged before the rest site ended, resulting in potentially odd results (including one fun report that turned an ally into an enemy)

Fixed a very small window during the Airship UI where multiple acts could be clicked, resulting in odd behavior

Fixed temporary potions not disappearing (again)

When acquiring the Only the Best specialization, the overhead Trait icons for existing Mythic units will now update with the new trait.

Fixed a rare case of a trait update error, where if you had a Marksman Dummy with a war banner, then took out Marksman by way of a swap with a benched unit, the benched unit's traits would not apply.

Added additional logging and potentially fixed a rare case where the Trait Brand specialization wouldn't activate.

Fixed a case where the end of run screen, when clicking the recap, could get stuck on the recap screen.

Fixed a rare issue where if a Contract was turned in at the travel panel for a Rest room, then immediately the Rest room was clicked, then the player gained units as a result of the chosen Perk, the Rest site could become unclickable and softlock. Levelling during a Rest site will now kick the level up into the next act rather than trying to resolve it immediately.

Fixed Impatient Monk in PVP not granting bonus stats since Overtime was switched to Damage Amp.

Fixed a rare display issue where the post-combat and Top Panel heart displays would get out of sync, particularly regarding Pale Hearts

Fixed a rare display issue where the final Heart in the top panel could get stuck as being shown as Pale.

Fixed Baalor's Summons causing the position the Unit spawned at to be considered blocked for the rest of the game until a return to main menu

Baalor's Skill VFX reduced in duration

Fixed Trollgar's swap ignoring CC immunity, resulting in potential AI breakage if a Unit was forced to move positions if they were in the middle of certain actions.

Unsellable units (such as Target Dummies) no longer count against the "Perfect Fights" end of run badge

Chester's Magic Coin will now show Statue as an option when you have the Grandmaster perk.

Added a keybinding for Pausing and Unpausing combat, defaulted to Space Bar

Added a message to the keybinds window to say these do not function if the Gameplay setting for enabling all keybinds is not enabled.
